issues.title: Implicit SQLite String Length Limits
issues.why: While the Postgres reference block has CHECK constraints for string lengths (e.g., 1-120 chars), the primary SQLite DDL lacks these, relying on application-layer enforcement.
issues.fix: Add CHECK(length(AppName) BETWEEN 1 AND 120) to the SQLite App table definition.

issues.title: Missing Index on AppSlug
issues.why: The AppSlug column is marked UNIQUE (which creates an implicit index), but for high-volume resolution, an explicit index is often preferred for clarity in audit logs.
issues.fix: The current UNIQUE constraint is sufficient for a mediocre coder, but adding an explicit index comment would clarify intent.

issues.title: Concurrency Retry Logic Detail
issues.why: The spec references the retry contract (3x100ms) but doesn't explicitly state if the 'mediocre coder' should implement the wrapper or assume the driver handles it.
issues.fix: Clarify that the database connection factory MUST wrap executions in the specified retry logic.
